# McDivot's Sports Bar and Restaurant

> Sports Bar in Tampa, Florida. TVs at every angle, ice cold beer and a kitchen that has been turning out legendary wings and handcrafted burgers in Westchase for over 25 years.

- Phone: (813) 814-9394
- Address: 10706 Countryway Blvd, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Gibsonton, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Wings; Burgers and sandwiches; Raw bar and starters
- Rating: 4.3 from 357 Google reviews
